description: This Java source file defines an abstract class MultiResourceRepository that manages a collection of LocalResourceRepository instances, providing methods for caching, merging, and invalidating resource items, primarily used in Android resource rendering.

classes.name: MultiResourceRepository
classes.description: An abstract class that manages multiple LocalResourceRepository instances, providing caching, merging, and invalidation functionalities for Android resource management.

methods.name: setChildren
methods.description: Sets the list of child repositories, updating parent relationships and modification counts.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns the list of child repositories.

methods.name: getModificationCount
methods.description: Returns the modification count, updating internal state if any child has changed.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Returns a map of resource types to resource items, initializing cache if necessary.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Returns a multimap of resource items for a specific resource type, merging data from children.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns all resource items as a map.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of child repositories and removes parent relationships.

methods.name: invalidateCache
methods.description: Invalidates cached resource items for a specific repository and resource types.

methods.name: isScanPending
methods.description: Checks if a scan is pending for a given PsiFile (used in testing).

methods.name: getChildCount
methods.description: Returns the number of child repositories.
